rules.name: statement_newline
rules.text:
statement_newline:
    | single_compound_stmt NEWLINE
    | simple_stmts
    | NEWLINE
    | ENDMARKER

rules.name: simple_stmt
rules.text:
simple_stmt:
    | assignment
    | type_alias
    | star_expressions
    | return_stmt
    | import_stmt
    | raise_stmt
    | pass_stmt
    | del_stmt
    | yield_stmt
    | assert_stmt
    | break_stmt
    | continue_stmt
    | global_stmt
    | nonlocal_stmt

rules.name: compound_stmt
rules.text:
compound_stmt:
    | function_def
    | if_stmt
    | class_def
    | with_stmt
    | for_stmt
    | try_stmt
    | while_stmt
    | match_stmt

rules.name: assignment
rules.text:
assignment:
    | NAME ':' expression ['=' annotated_rhs]
    | ('(' single_target ')' | single_subscript_attribute_target) ':' expression ['=' annotated_rhs]
    | (star_targets '=')+ annotated_rhs !'=' [TYPE_COMMENT]
    | single_target augassign ~ annotated_rhs

    | ('(' single_target ')' | single_subscript_attribute_target) ':' expression ['=' annotated_rhs]
    | (star_targets '=')+ annotated_rhs !'=' [TYPE_COMMENT]
    | single_target augassign ~ annotated_rhs

rules.name: block
rules.text:
block:
    | NEWLINE INDENT statements DEDENT
    | simple_stmts
rules.sourceLiteral:
block:
    | NEWLINE INDENT statements DEDENT
    | simple_stmts

rules.name: function_def_raw
rules.text:
function_def_raw:
    | 'def' NAME [type_params] '(' [params] ')' ['->' expression] ':' [func_type_comment] block
    | 'async' 'def' NAME [type_params] '(' [params] ')' ['->' expression] ':' [func_type_comment] block

rules.name: parameters
rules.text:
parameters:
    | slash_no_default param_no_default* param_with_default* [star_etc]
    | slash_with_default param_with_default* [star_etc]
    | param_no_default+ param_with_default* [star_etc]
    | param_with_default+ [star_etc]
    | star_etc

    | slash_no_default param_no_default* param_with_default* [star_etc]
    | slash_with_default param_with_default* [star_etc]
    | param_no_default+ param_with_default* [star_etc]
    | param_with_default+ [star_etc]
    | star_etc

rules.name: star_etc
rules.text:
star_etc:
    | '*' param_no_default param_maybe_default* [kwds]
    | '*' param_no_default_star_annotation param_maybe_default* [kwds]
    | '*' ',' param_maybe_default+ [kwds]
    | kwds

    | '*' param_no_default param_maybe_default* [kwds]
    | '*' param_no_default_star_annotation param_maybe_default* [kwds]
    | '*' ',' param_maybe_default+ [kwds]
    | kwds

rules.name: param_with_default
rules.text:
param_with_default:
    | param default ',' TYPE_COMMENT?
    | param default TYPE_COMMENT? &')'

    | param default TYPE_COMMENT? &')'

rules.name: param_maybe_default

rules.name: if_stmt
rules.text:
if_stmt:
    | 'if' named_expression ':' block elif_stmt
    | 'if' named_expression ':' block [else_block]

rules.name: for_stmt
rules.text:
for_stmt:
    | 'for' star_targets 'in' ~ star_expressions ':' [TYPE_COMMENT] block [else_block]
    | 'async' 'for' star_targets 'in' ~ star_expressions ':' [TYPE_COMMENT] block [else_block]

rules.name: try_stmt
rules.text:
try_stmt:
    | 'try' ':' block finally_block
    | 'try' ':' block except_block+ [else_block] [finally_block]
    | 'try' ':' block except_star_block+ [else_block] [finally_block]

rules.name: except_block
rules.text:
except_block:
    | 'except' expression ':' block
    | 'except' expression 'as' NAME ':' block
    | 'except' expressions ':' block
    | 'except' ':' block

match_stmt:
